messages:
kai: Kumo-v1 int8 smoke shows BLEU drop on vertical JP with ruby + embedded RTL punctuation. Anyone seen punctuation migration across ruby boundaries?

meera: paste small repro and eval delta?

kai: repro:
```
INPUT: 漢[ふり]{ruby}«بين»
REF: "Kanji (furigana) «Byn»"
KUMO-v0.8: "Kanji (furigana) «Byn»"
KUMO-v1-int8: "Kanji«Byn» (furigana)"
BLEU 29.1 -> 25.6 (−3.5)
```

tokenizer-bot: Running tokenizer trace...

ops-lee: Token diff shows ZWJ/ZWSP moved after ruby-open in int8 run.

meera: Which change landed recently? Normalizer PR ~3601234400 and int8 packing change in runtime ~3601234500. Need to bisect.

kai: Quick test: set USE_LEGACY_TOKENIZER=1 with int8 binary => BLEU 28.9, so tokenizer change is likely culprit.

ci-bot: Created ticket INF-3377: "kumo int8 tokenization reorder with vertical+ruby+RTL punctuation". Assigning @mika to review normalizer revert/opt-out and add regression test.

meera: add tokenizer trace to smoke artifacts and run extended locale suite once revert is staged.

kai: will open PR for opt-out flag and regression case.
